data.name: Aldredge
data.long_meaning: The name Aldredge is derived from Old English, where it is composed of two parts: 'ald' meaning old and 'redg' meaning counselor or advice. This name carries the meaning of an old, wise, and powerful advisor.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name reminding us to seek wisdom and counsel from the divine.
